thread:
emma_marketing: Quick debrief  Interview + perf session with NebulaGrid done today. Raw video + full transcript + benchmark exports uploaded: https://drive.redwood/nebulagrid. Theyre excited about the throughput gains from Redwood Optimize. Need: 1) approved customer quote, 2) legal sign-off on any numeric claims, 3) webinar landing copy and routing plan. Target embargo: Aug 12.

ryan_growth: Nice. Growth wants the headline to focus on "throughput and unit cost" improvements. Sales will tag leads and route high-intent registrants to the dedicated demo queue. Can we get a short 1-line stat for the hero?

jose_pm: We ran a side-by-side E2E workload: NebulaGrid saw ~1.8x throughput on the same hardware after applying Redwood Optimize configs. That number comes from our internal bench harness; NebulaGrid needs to OK publishing it.

leah_legal: Please do not publish the 1.8x figure until NebulaGrid signs a confirmation email. Also need their signed media release on file. If theyre uncomfortable with the ratio, we can use qualitative language like "measurable throughput improvements."

emma_marketing: Uploaded a media release and 3 quote options (exec, technical, short soundbite): https://drive.redwood/nebulagrid/quotes. /cc @leah_legal

max_design: Once copy is locked Ill mock a hero with two variants: a stat headline and a qualitative headline + a short 45s clip. Need final CTA to wire up the landing page. Asset freeze target Aug 10 EOD.

vera_sales: Routing: set utm=nebulagrid_launch; tag registrants with prospect-segment=midmarket+infra. Sales follow-up: AE outreach for attendees who watch >60% within 24h. Also want a gated appendix with the full benchmark for enterprise motions.

benchmark-bot: Reminder: benchmark artifacts should include raw harness logs and repro steps for transparency. Upload deadline: 1768800000 (Aug 8 20:00 UTC).

jose_pm: Well ask NebulaGrid to confirm the 1.8x and provide a short blurb about the workload (batch size, seq len). If they decline, well publish the sanitized chart and keep numbers in the gated appendix.

leah_legal: Ive messaged their counsel asking for approval on the throughput figure and the release. If they request any edits, Ill post changes to the quote text here. ETA 48 hours.

emma_marketing: Draft webinar title options in the folder: "How NebulaGrid doubled throughput with Redwood Optimize" (stat), "Scaling inference without the cloud bill shock" (qual). Which CTA do we prefer? "Register for the live webinar" or "Get the case study + demo"?

ryan_growth: Prefer "Register for the live webinar" for top-funnel; include a secondary CTA in emails: "Get the full benchmark appendix (sales only)". Add lead scoring: +20 if they download appendix.

max_design: Ill produce both CTAs in the hero & two email subject line options. Will mock mobile-first variants.

vera_sales: Webinar scheduling recommendation: Thurs Aug 12 at 11am PT to align APAC/EMEA overlap. Enable recording gated behind email capture. Routing note: API will tag leads with "nebulagrid-webinar" and route to the midmarket demo workflow if they meet engagement triggers.

jose_pm: Also request NebulaGrid confirm we can use a small anonymized P95 chart with axes labeled but without raw tick numbers if theyre sensitive. That gives a visual without exposing customer metrics.

leah_legal: Good approach. If they sign-off on anonymized axes only, we can publish. Otherwise keep any sensitive charts in the gated appendix. Also confirm we have a signed release that allows logo use.

emma_marketing: Ill follow up with NebulaGrid for the 1-line stat and logo permission. Plan: lock quote + legal ok by Aug 5, finalize assets by Aug 10, open registration Aug 3, embargo publish Aug 12 morning. Ill post final assets and routing snippets in this thread. :rocket:
